title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard
score_scale: 0-5 per point; weights are fractions of the area total

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.guidance: 2-D compressible Navier-Stokes for a calorically perfect gas written in conservative form; closure p=(gamma-1)rho e; nondimensionalization consistent with case reference quantities; force coefficients defined correctly.
points.evidence: Source flux assembly and report equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.guidance: Reads CGNS unstructured zones and boundary families; computes cell volumes, face areas/normals/centers; handles mixed cells and multi-zone meshes; builds cell-face adjacency for partitioning and reconstruction.
points.evidence: Mesh reader code, geometry tests, partition diagnostics.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.guidance: Cell-centered FV residual with correct face orientation, consistent flux signs, boundary-face treatment; residual assembled once per iteration with global MPI reduction.
points.evidence: residual assembly code; residuals.csv shows global reduction.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.guidance: Rusanov/LLF minimum or Roe-type with entropy fix; flux matches the stated method; no loss of conservation at boundaries.
points.evidence: Flux implementation; metadata inviscid_flux/entropy_fix; code walkthrough.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.guidance: Farfield, inviscid slip wall, no-slip adiabatic wall; wall treatment honest (boundary_value vs cell_center in surface output); near-zero wall velocity for no-slip; near-zero normal velocity for slip.
points.evidence: BC code; surface.csv checks; metadata wall_boundary_output_semantics.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.guidance: Least-squares/Green-Gauss gradients; piecewise-linear face states; reconstruction ACTIVE in production runs; first-order fallback triggers documented and disclosed.
points.evidence: Gradient/reconstruction code; metadata reconstruction field; report disclosure.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.guidance: Barth-Jespersen or stronger limiter active in production; positivity protection for reconstructed density/pressure and updates.
points.evidence: Limiter code; metadata limiter/positivity_preservation; shock-captured fields.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.guidance: Velocity/temperature gradients on unstructured cells; Newtonian stress tensor and Fourier heat flux; viscosity matches case Reynolds number; wall-normal gradient treatment; pressure vs tangential skin-friction split.
points.evidence: Viscous flux code; forces.csv viscous columns; report formulas.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.guidance: LU-SGS/matrix-free/block-Jacobi or equivalent with documented Jacobian approximation; CFL ramp/local time stepping honoring case CFL controls; meaningful residual reduction.
points.evidence: Implicit solver code; residuals.csv; metadata time_integrator/implicit_solver.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.guidance: True physical-time outer loop with inner iterations at each step (dt=0.01, t_final=300, 5-1000 inner iterations, inner target 1e-3, frozen BDF2 histories) or stricter documented equivalent; real inner-iteration statistics reported.
points.evidence: Time loop code; metadata true_bdf2_inner_loop + inner stats; forces.csv unsteady behavior.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.guidance: METIS/ParMETIS cell-graph partition with owned/ghost counts, neighbor ranks, send/recv sizes per rank; load balance and edge cut documented; np=8 runs for NACA and cylinder with comparable forces.
points.evidence: partition_diagnostics.csv; metadata partitioner; rank comparison runs.

disqualification_flags: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
